title: Runner: execute ROUND/FOREACH_TASK semantics
notes: Stop flatten-only execution for v2 container nodes. Execute pipeline AST with true control flow: steps outside FOREACH_TASK run once per run (or per ROUND iteration), steps inside FOREACH_TASK run per task. Persist an execution cursor (round_index, task_index, ast_path) in `autonovelwriter/runtime/state/runner_state.json` (or project state) so pause/restart resumes without repeating completed steps. Keep driver-stage vs in-app pipeline separation explicit in logs/events.
acceptance: Given a script with `ROUND 2` containing `STEP meta_tasks_generate` then `FOREACH_TASK` children, `meta_tasks_generate` runs once per round (not once per task) and `write` runs for each task.
Runner persists a resume cursor and, after process restart, continues from the next unfinished (round, task, block) without duplicating already-done outputs.
WS `run_status`/`task_status` and `runner.log` reflect container context (round index, task id, block type).

title: PWA: insert LOOP/ROUND/FOREACH_TASK blocks
notes: Add UI controls to create container blocks (LOOP, ROUND, FOREACH_TASK) directly in the Blocks view (not only by hand-editing script). Support setting/editing repeat for LOOP/ROUND (reuse existing repeat editor), and ensure indent/outdent + drag-reorder works with the new containers. Canonical artifact remains the formatted script: any UI change must immediately update `pipeline.script` textarea via AST->script render.
acceptance: User can insert a `ROUND` or `FOREACH_TASK` container from the Blocks UI and the canonical script updates immediately with correct 2-space indentation.
User can edit LOOP/ROUND repeat counts and the script updates immediately; invalid repeats show localized inline feedback.
All new UI strings are localized for 11 UI languages and Arabic remains RTL-safe.

title: Task batches: index API + PWA panel
notes: Make generated task batches first-class. Add backend API `GET /api/tasks/batches/index` listing batches under `autonovelwriter/runtime/tasks/batches/` (id, created time, task_count, paths), and a PWA panel to display them. Hook WS `tasks_batch_created` to refresh the panel and show an immediate UI notification. Keep this separate from the driver queue under `references/autonovelwriter_dev/`.
acceptance: Backend `GET /api/tasks/batches/index` returns batches with stable fields (batch_id, batch_dir, tasks_jsonl, task_count, created_utc).
PWA displays the batches list and refreshes automatically on WS `tasks_batch_created` without requiring manual reload.
Feature is fully operable without binding extra ports in tests: backend import/py_compile passes, PWA `node --check` passes, and a unit-style call can index batches from disk.
